title: TimeLakeDB — Node Console
description: Operator plane for a TimeLakeDB node, read from the node's own _system database over Flight SQL (docs/CONSOLE.md §7.3/§7.6, phase U2). Panels are grouped as Overview / Query / Ingest / Storage / Security. TWO THINGS TO KNOW. (1) This reads the database through the database: if the node is too unhealthy to serve SQL these panels go blank, and /metrics on port 1963 is the surface that still answers — scrape that for alerting. (2) Every panel here uses only metrics a node ALWAYS emits. Conditional subsystems (TLS, S3, KMS, cluster roles) emit nothing until configured, and a metric never emitted has no column in _system, so a panel referencing one fails with a query error rather than showing 'no data'. Add those panels per deployment; CONSOLE.md §7.6 has the queries.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(timelake_uptime_seconds) AS uptime FROM metrics WHERE timelake_uptime_seconds IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS queries FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'

panels.title: p95 query latency (1h)
panels.description: From the per-query rows, not from histogram buckets — this is the real distribution, so it is a measurement rather than an estimate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95) AS p95_ms FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT MAX(timelake_buffer_rows) AS buffer_rows FROM metrics WHERE timelake_buffer_rows IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT MAX(timelake_parquet_files) AS files FROM metrics WHERE timelake_parquet_files IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.title: Samples dropped
panels.description: Self-monitoring rows the sampler discarded because its bounded queue was full. Anything above zero means these panels have gaps — the numbers on /metrics do not.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(timelake_selfmon_dropped_total) AS dropped FROM metrics WHERE timelake_selfmon_dropped_total IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.title: Query — the view that pays for itself (PR-3, PR-6)
Query latency percentiles, 1-min bins
panels.description: p50/p95/p99 computed from actual per-query durations. Shape A's target is 250 ms (PR-3); M4 measured a 608 ms p95.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.5) AS p50, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.95) AS p95, approx_percentile_cont(duration_ms, 0.99) AS p99 FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Query rate by outcome, 1-min bins
panels.description: `refused` is the read-only guard working (P0-2), not a fault — it is charted apart from `failed` so a client probing COPY does not read as an outage.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, outcome, COUNT(*) AS n FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Admission wait p95, 1-min bins
panels.description: Time queued on the RR-1 admission semaphore. High wait with low duration means the node is saturated, not slow — opposite remedies.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, approx_percentile_cont(wait_ms, 0.95) AS wait_p95 FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_query_in_flight) AS in_flight, MAX(timelake_query_queued) AS queued FROM metrics WHERE timelake_query_in_flight IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Slowest queries (3h)
panels.description: `ref` matches the id in a sanitized error message (SEC-5), so a user complaint maps to the full error in the server log.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, db, outcome, duration_ms, rows, ref FROM queries WHERE time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' ORDER BY duration_ms DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Lines written per second, 1-min bins
panels.description: A counter differenced within each bin. Self-monitoring rows are deliberately excluded from this counter, so it stays comparable with Gauge's throughput numbers.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, (MAX(timelake_lines_written_total) - MIN(timelake_lines_written_total)) / 60.0 AS lines_per_sec FROM metrics WHERE timelake_lines_written_total IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Writes refused by cause, 1-min bins
panels.description: `backpressure` is the RR-5 WAL cap and is yours to act on; `bad_request` is the client's problem. Charting them together would hide which.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, reason, MAX(timelake_write_rejected_total) AS refused FROM metrics WHERE timelake_write_rejected_total IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_wal_bytes) AS wal_bytes, MAX(timelake_buffer_rows) AS buffer_rows FROM metrics WHERE timelake_wal_bytes IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Flush and compaction lag
panels.description: Seconds since each last completed. With nothing having run yet these report the node's whole uptime, which is the honest reading — a zero would look healthy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_flush_lag_seconds) AS flush_lag, MAX(timelake_compaction_lag_seconds) AS compaction_lag FROM metrics WHERE timelake_flush_lag_seconds IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', time) AS time, "table", MAX(timelake_storage_bytes) AS bytes FROM metrics WHERE timelake_storage_bytes IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Files by level, 5-min bins
panels.description: L0 growing faster than `compacted` drains it is the compaction-lag signal (PR-6).

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', time) AS time, level, MAX(timelake_files) AS files FROM metrics WHERE timelake_files IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT "table", MAX(timelake_storage_bytes) AS bytes, MAX(timelake_storage_rows) AS rows FROM metrics WHERE timelake_storage_bytes IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: GC pending files and retention drops

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_gc_pending_files) AS gc_pending, MAX(timelake_retention_drops_total) AS retention_drops FROM metrics WHERE timelake_gc_pending_files IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Default admin credential active
panels.description: SEC-4: 1 means the seeded admin/admin password has never been rotated. Alert on this.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(timelake_admin_default_credential_active) AS default_credential FROM metrics WHERE timelake_admin_default_credential_active IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.title: Data-plane auth mode
panels.description: SEC-4 phased: 0 = off (no token required), 1 = optional, 2 = required. A TLS certificate-expiry panel is NOT included by default — see the dashboard description and CONSOLE.md §7.6: a metric the node has never emitted has no column in _system, so a TLS panel errors on a plaintext node instead of showing 'no data'. Add it on TLS deployments.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(timelake_data_auth_mode) AS auth_mode FROM metrics WHERE timelake_data_auth_mode IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.title: Audit sink healthy
panels.description: SR-6: 0 means admin mutations are being refused (fail-closed) until the trail can be written.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(timelake_audit_sink_healthy) AS healthy FROM metrics WHERE timelake_audit_sink_healthy IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
SELECT MAX(timelake_encryption_enabled) AS encrypted FROM metrics WHERE timelake_encryption_enabled IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'

panels.title: Admin login failures and rate-limited queries, 1-min bins

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_admin_login_failures_total) AS login_failures, MAX(timelake_query_rate_limited_total) AS rate_limited FROM metrics WHERE timelake_admin_login_failures_total IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Rows filtered by visibility labels, 1-min bins
panels.description: SEC-2: rows the mandatory predicate withheld. A step change means a caller's authorizations changed, or a label did.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', time) AS time, MAX(timelake_visibility_rows_filtered_total) AS rows_filtered FROM metrics WHERE timelake_visibility_rows_filtered_total IS NOT NULL AND time >= now() - INTERVAL '3 hours' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
